prompt: Which are real Copilot capabilities on GitHub today? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Copilot spans completions, chat, and agents that propose changes for review. Merging without humans is not a Copilot feature — review stays a person’s call.

options.text: Inline code completions in supported editors
Chat about your code in the editor
An agent that takes an issue and opens a pull request
Silently merging pull requests without human review
Writing commit messages as its only function
